$comment: The DAK's data dictionary (component 5 of a WHO SMART Guidelines DAK): the data each journey records or exchanges, one logical model per data set. tools/ig-gen/ig_gen.py writes the FHIR logical models, their mappings to this guide's profiles and examples, the data-element and code-list CodeSystems and ValueSets (input/fsh/dak/) and the Data Dictionary page (input/pagecontent/dictionary.md) from this file; tools/repo-checks/repo_checks.py checks that every process, task, requirement and FHIR artifact it names exists. A model's `serves` names the BPMN tasks that record or read its data; an element's `maps` says where this guide realises it.

codeLists.title: Result of reading a DVC
codeLists.description: What the HCERT library returns for one scanned DVC: a verified result, a failed result naming the step and reason (STT-VER-008), or the distinct result of the unverified triage read (STT-VER-011).

codes.definition: Every step of verification passed (STT-VER-001).
Verification stopped at a step, for a reason from the closed set of STT-VER-008.
The payload was read by read-unverified, with no trust lookup or signature check (STT-VER-011).

codeLists.title: Verification steps
codeLists.description: The steps of DVC verification in the order they run (STT-VER-001), as the HCERT library names them in its typed result (STT-VER-008).

codes.definition: The HC1: context prefix and version.
Base45 decoding of the QR text.
ZLIB decompression, within limits.
Parsing the COSE_Sign1 structure.
The protected and unprotected headers.
Finding the signer's certificate by kid on the trust list.
Checking the signature with the signer's key.
Checking the signer's certificate may sign this kind of certificate.
Reading the CWT claim set.
Checking issued-at and expiry against the verifier's clock.
Finding the hcert claim and its subclaim.
Reading the payload against its logical model.

codeLists.title: Verification failure reasons
codeLists.description: The closed set of reasons a DVC fails verification, shared by the Kotlin and Rust HCERT libraries (STT-VER-008).

codes.definition: The text does not start with the HC1: prefix.
The context identifier names a version the verifier does not support.
The text is not valid Base45.
The compressed bytes do not decompress.
A decode limit (size or depth) was exceeded.
The bytes are not a well-formed COSE_Sign1.
A COSE header is missing or not as required.
The signature algorithm is not one the verifier accepts.
No certificate on the verifier's copy of the trust list has the kid (STT-VER-006).
The signature does not verify with any certificate with the kid.
The signer's certificate may not sign this kind of certificate.
The certificate's expiry has passed.
The certificate's issued-at time is in the future.
The claim set has no hcert claim.
The hcert claim has more subclaims than the verifier accepts.
The payload does not conform to its logical model.

codeLists.title: What a scanned DVC becomes in the record
codeLists.description: The outcome of decision table TD.DT.01 for one scanned DVC.

codes.definition: Recorded from its primary source, with provenance of the verification.
Kept as reported by the family (primarySource false); not counted by the schedule.
The certificate is not evidence of a dose; the step and reason are recorded.
Nothing could be read from the QR; the card is treated as paper.

codeLists.title: How an imported dose got its national schedule code
codeLists.description: The outcome of decision table TD.DT.02 (STD-SEM-001).

codes.definition: The issuer's product code has an equivalent schedule code in the national map.
The map had no entry; the clinician confirmed the equivalent, and the decision is added to the map.
No equivalent is known; the issuer's code is kept as it is and shown as unmapped.
The dose was not verified, so it was not imported and not mapped.

codeLists.title: Why a shared link released nothing
codeLists.description: The refusal reasons of decision table TD.DT.05 (STD-ACC-001).

codes.definition: The holder withdrew the link before it expired.
The request came after the expiry the holder chose.
The passcode given does not match the one the holder set.

models.title: Birth-dose DVC
models.description: What the birth hospital records for each birth dose and signs into one Digital Vaccination Certificate (DVC, an HCERT) per dose: the payload, the CWT claims and the key that signs it.

elements.label: Name
elements.definition: The child's name as the birth hospital records it.

elements.label: Date of birth
elements.definition: The child's date of birth.

elements.label: Parent or guardian name
elements.definition: The parent or guardian, for a subject with no identity document such as a newborn (STT-PAY-005).

elements.label: Hospital number
elements.definition: The birth hospital's own identifier for the child. It is not carried in the DVC.

elements.label: Vaccine product
elements.definition: The product given, in the issuer's product coding (illustrative PreQual-style codes).

elements.label: Date of vaccination
elements.definition: The date the dose was given. The hospital record holds the time as well; the DVC carries the date.

elements.label: Batch number
elements.definition: The batch (lot) of the vaccine given.

elements.label: Dose number
elements.definition: The dose's number in its series. Recorded by the hospital; the minimal DVC payload does not carry it.

elements.label: Supervising clinician
elements.definition: The clinician who gave or supervised the dose.

elements.label: Issuing country
elements.definition: The trust-network participant whose key signs the DVC (J1: XXR).

elements.label: Issued at
elements.definition: When the DVC was signed.

elements.label: Expires at
elements.definition: When the DVC stops verifying, where the issuer sets an expiry.

elements.label: Key identifier (kid)
elements.definition: Identifies the document signer certificate on the trust list that verifies the DVC (J1: 916ffa567c0f44a2).

models.title: Newborn registration on a home visit
models.description: What the community health worker records offline when she finds a newborn missing from the household roster: the registration form's answers and each dose read from a foreign card without verifying it.

elements.label: Household id
elements.definition: The household on the CHW's roster that the child joins.

elements.label: Child's given name
elements.definition: The child's given name.

elements.label: Child's family name
elements.definition: The child's family name.

elements.label: Date of birth
elements.definition: The child's date of birth.

elements.label: Country of birth
elements.definition: The country the child was born in, when abroad.

elements.label: Foreign vaccination cards held
elements.definition: Whether the family holds vaccination cards from abroad.

elements.label: Temporary id
elements.definition: The id the child carries until civil registration catches up.

elements.label: Registered by
elements.definition: The community health worker who registered the child.

elements.label: Registered at
elements.definition: When the registration was captured, on the phone, possibly offline.

elements.label: Informant
elements.definition: The family member who gave the answers.

elements.label: Dose read from a foreign card
elements.definition: One dose read from a foreign DVC with the unverified triage read (STT-VER-011), saved as reported by the family.

elements.label: Vaccine product (as read)
elements.definition: The issuer's product code as read from the card; no national code is added yet.

elements.label: Date of vaccination (as read)
elements.definition: The date of vaccination as read from the card.

elements.label: Batch number (as read)
elements.definition: The batch number as read from the card.

elements.label: Reported by
elements.definition: The family member who showed the card: the dose's information source.

elements.label: Record outcome
elements.definition: Always reported-unverified for a triage read (decision table TD.DT.01); recorded as primarySource false with a note.

models.title: Referral for verification
models.description: The community health worker's referral of the child to the home clinic, to verify the foreign cards and fit the doses to the national schedule.

elements.label: Child
elements.definition: The child referred.

elements.label: Referred by
elements.definition: The community health worker who made the referral.

elements.label: Referred to
elements.definition: The clinic that will verify the cards.

elements.label: Referred at
elements.definition: When the referral was made.

elements.label: Reason
elements.definition: Why the child is referred: unverified foreign vaccination cards.

elements.label: Doses to verify
elements.definition: The reported doses the clinic is asked to verify.

elements.label: Referral status
elements.definition: Active until the clinic records an outcome for every dose it lists, then completed (indicator TD.IND.03).

models.title: DVC verification and import
models.description: What the clinic records when it verifies a foreign DVC against its cached copy of the trust list, and, when the DVC verifies, imports the dose in place of the reported one.

elements.label: Key identifier (kid)
elements.definition: The kid of the DVC verified, which names the signer's certificate.

elements.label: Issuing country
elements.definition: The participant that signed the DVC (CWT iss).

elements.label: Verified at
elements.definition: When the verification ran.

elements.label: Verifier
elements.definition: The system that verified the DVC.

elements.label: Verification result
elements.definition: The library's typed result (STT-VER-008).

elements.label: Failed step
elements.definition: The step at which verification stopped, when it failed.
maps: not yet realised in the examples (J3's DVCs verify)

elements.label: Failure reason
elements.definition: Why verification stopped, when it failed: the input of decision table TD.DT.01.
maps: not yet realised in the examples (J3's DVCs verify)

elements.label: Trust list refreshed at
elements.definition: When the verifier last refreshed its cached copy of the trust list; a signer added since then fails with KidNotFound (STT-VER-006).
maps: not yet realised in the examples

elements.label: Record outcome
elements.definition: What the DVC becomes in the record (decision table TD.DT.01).

elements.label: Imported dose
elements.definition: The dose recorded from the verified DVC.

elements.label: Reported dose replaced
elements.definition: The reported dose the verified one replaces.

elements.label: Trust policy
elements.definition: The trust framework the DVC was verified under.

models.title: Imported dose and schedule
models.description: What the clinic records for each imported dose's vaccine code, and what the national schedule finds due once the doses are counted.

elements.label: Issuer's product code
elements.definition: The vaccine code as the issuer signed it; kept, never replaced (STD-SEM-001).

elements.label: National schedule code
elements.definition: The national schedule's antigen-and-dose code, added beside the product code. Absent for an unmapped dose, which the TrustDemoLaoImmunization profile (laoEpi 1..1) does not yet represent.

elements.label: Mapping basis
elements.definition: How the schedule code was found (decision table TD.DT.02).

elements.label: Confirmed by
elements.definition: The clinician who confirmed an equivalent the map did not cover.

elements.label: Counts toward the schedule
elements.definition: Whether the schedule counts the dose (decision table TD.DT.03): only doses from a primary source with a national schedule code.

elements.label: Dose due
elements.definition: A dose of the national schedule the evaluation finds due (decision table TD.DT.04).

elements.label: Schedule dose
elements.definition: The schedule's antigen-and-dose code of the dose due.

elements.label: Forecast status
elements.definition: The forecast for the dose.

elements.label: Due date
elements.definition: The child's date of birth plus the schedule action's timing age.

elements.label: Reminder
elements.definition: The reminder created for the next visit.

models.title: Shared link and consent
models.description: What the home country records when the holder shares a family member's summary as a Verifiable Health Link (VHL): who may read what, for how long, and that a passcode protects it.

elements.label: Subject
elements.definition: The family member whose summary is shared.

elements.label: Holder
elements.definition: The person who shares the link and decides who may open it.

elements.label: Custodian
elements.definition: The home-country service that hosts the record and checks every request.

elements.label: Shared document
elements.definition: The patient summary the link releases.

elements.label: Valid from
elements.definition: The first day the link may be opened.

elements.label: Valid until
elements.definition: The expiry the holder chose; after it the link releases nothing (STD-ACC-001).

elements.label: Purpose
elements.definition: The purpose of use the holder allows (J4: treatment).

elements.label: Passcode set
elements.definition: Whether the holder protected the link with a passcode. The passcode itself is never stored in the record.
maps: the link's passcode flag (IHE ITI VHL); not in Consent

elements.label: Withdrawn at
elements.definition: When the holder withdrew the link, if they did.
maps: Consent.status = inactive; not yet realised in the examples

models.title: Access to a shared link
models.description: What the home country logs for every request to open a shared link, released or refused.

elements.label: Requested at
elements.definition: When the request arrived.

elements.label: Requester
elements.definition: The receiving system abroad that asked for the manifest.

elements.label: Requester network address
elements.definition: Where the request came from.

elements.label: Custodian
elements.definition: The home-country gateway that answered and logged the request.

elements.label: Patient
elements.definition: Whose record was asked for.

elements.label: Released
elements.definition: Whether the manifest was released (decision table TD.DT.05).

elements.label: Audit outcome
elements.definition: 0 when released; 4 (minor failure) when refused.

elements.label: Refusal reason
elements.definition: Why nothing was released, when refused.

elements.label: Consent
elements.definition: The holder's consent the request was checked against.

elements.label: Document released
elements.definition: The summary released, when released.
